description: This file is a PHP test class that performs unit testing for the ClaimRequestActionAPI class related to the Claim plugin in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, mock service registration, and test methods for API endpoints such as update, delete, and get operations, with some tests expecting not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimRequestActionAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. Includes setup, mock service configuration, and test cases for update, delete, and retrieval operations.
